Game Overview

Urban Sniper Multiplayer is a adventure title where engage in nerve-wracking sniper duels as you navigate a dynamic urban landscape. Flex your strategic acumen, stay hidden, and remain vigilant. Every rooftop and alleyway is fraught with danger. With an unflinching eye, seize the moment to strike, outmaneuvering rivals in a relentless battle for supremacy.
